title: Child Waving on Riverbank, 1965 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white square snapshot photo stamped SEP 65 along the bottom margin. The image depicts a young child sitting at the edge of a high earthen bank or river ledge above a calm body of water, raising a hand in a wave. Surrounded by trees and natural foliage, the scene captures an intimate moment of mid-century summer leisure and childhood outdoor play in rural America.
